common.tagline: AI drafts the map. You craft the learning.

topbar.installSafariGuide: On Mac Safari: click 'File' in the top menu bar -> 'Add to Dock' to install MapCraft as a standalone desktop app!
topbar.installWindowsGuide:
On Windows (Chrome / Edge):
1. Click the 'Install' or 'Open in app' icon on the right side of the address bar.
2. Or click the browser menu '⋮' -> 'Save and share' -> 'Create shortcut...' and check 'Open as window' to generate a desktop shortcut with the new icon!

settings.title: Settings & LLM Connections
settings.subtitle: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK). All credentials remain on your device and are never sent to third-party servers.

settings.clearLessonsConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear cached AI lesson notes? Maps and learning progress will be preserved.

cloud.title: Local-First Google Cloud Sync & Share
cloud.subtitle: All reads and writes happen locally in milliseconds. Sign in with Google to automatically sync in the background and share maps with others.
cloud.loginGoogleBtn: Sign in with Google to Enable Cloud Sync
cloud.loginGoogleHint: Signing in with Google automatically syncs your maps and progress across devices, and lets you generate cloud links to share full lessons with others!
cloud.shareBenefit: 💡 Note: After signing in with Google, you can generate shareable cloud links with 1 click so anyone can view your full learning map and lessons!
cloud.autoSyncDesc: Automatically syncs maps, node progress, and generated lessons to Google Drive in the background.
cloud.advancedSettingsDesc: Regular users do not need to configure this; simply click the sign-in button above. If you have your own Google Cloud project, you can provide a custom Client ID or Access Token here.
cloud.syncSuccessMsg: Successfully merged and synced with Google Drive!
cloud.disconnectedMsg: Signed out of Google (local data preserved).

share.modalSubtitle: Share instantly via compressed URL link or full cloud file via Google Drive.

share.tabUrlDesc: Compresses the map directly into a shareable URL. Recipients can view it online immediately and save it to their own library.

share.urlSkeletonOnly: ℹ️ Due to large lesson size, URL contains map structure & progress (~{{kb}} KB). Use Google Drive share below to include all full lessons.
share.tabDriveTitle: Option A: Google Drive Cloud Share (Full Map + All Lessons)
share.tabDriveDesc: Uploads this map and all generated lessons to your Google Drive (MapCraft folder) and generates a shareable cloud link with no size limits.
share.publishDriveBtn: Upload to Google Drive & Get Share Link
share.needDriveConfig: Not signed in with Google yet. Please sign in via Settings to enable full cloud sharing and auto-sync.
share.invalidShareDesc: The share link may be corrupted, or the Google Drive file requires permission.
